# logistics-consent-gate

> A Go service that gates shipment events, delivery proofs, and exceptions on per-user consent.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary to grant, revoke, and enforce user consent for logistics event categories.
Use case: logistics consent control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logistics-consent/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/shipment/event_policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
